architecture.candidate_domain: cartesian product of amino-acid states observed at each of the four positions, excluding the 588 visible variants
architecture.dream_status: WARM if at least one pair-state is observed; DORMANT otherwise
architecture.lambda_pair: median support across observed position-pair-state cells
architecture.lightning_score: additive memory + mean(weighted pair residuals over observed pair states)
architecture.main_shrinkage: n/(n+lambda_main), lambda_main = median support across observed position-state cells
architecture.pair_residual: visible pair-state mean minus global mean and shrunk main effects, then n/(n+lambda_pair)
architecture.relative_resonance_weight: abs(2*((rank-0.5)/N)-1) within each position-pair residual distribution

matched_controls.ADDITIVE_MEMORY: same visible data and main effects, no pair resonance
matched_controls.RANDOM_HASH: SHA256 lexical hash ordering, no fitness information
matched_controls.RIDGE_MAIN_PAIR: one-hot 4 single-state + 6 pair-state features, RidgeCV 17 logspace alphas 1e-4..1e4, deterministic 5-fold KFold random_state=161
matched_controls.SHUFFLE_CONTROL: after primary freeze/reveal, permute visible fitness deterministically with seed 161 and rerun unchanged Lightning

post_reveal_rule: No tuning on TrpB. Any change after reveal creates a new version and requires a new untouched benchmark.
reveal_budget: Top-10 per primary arm; evaluate union only after all arms are frozen

strict_shareable_pass.gate_1: Lightning mean Top-10 > best of additive, ridge, random
strict_shareable_pass.gate_2: Lightning mean Top-5 > best of additive, ridge, random
strict_shareable_pass.gate_3: Lightning fraction Top-10 above WT >= best matched baseline
strict_shareable_pass.gate_4: shuffled-label Lightning mean Top-10 <= 50% of true-label Lightning mean Top-10

visible_selection.rule: six fixed non-overlapping 98-row windows from the 5000-row superset; row numbers are 1-indexed data rows after the CSV header
